database_status: Twelve FAO-56 Table 11/12 example crop water profiles (stage lengths and single crop Kc). Only 10 annual crops are candidate rotations; flooded rice and perennial multi-cut alfalfa are quantified as ETc only pending management data. No field-specific crop-suitability claim. Crop-family diversity uses botanical families (Poaceae, Fabaceae, etc.), not harvest-use categories.

wheat.name: Winter wheat (grain)
wheat.kc_basis: FAO56 Table 12 winter wheat non-frozen soils, Kc end 0.35 within 0.25–0.4 range
wheat.duration_basis: FAO56 Table 11 barley/oats/wheat 120 day example (Central India); NOT Egypt-specific
wheat.note: Representative wheat proxy. Verify Egypt-specific growth period and cultivar before on-farm use. Sowing day remains original pilot convention, NOT an extension-service calendar.
wheat.model_scope: Original FAO-56 representative example; not Egypt-calibrated

faba.name: Faba bean (fresh harvest)
faba.kc_basis: FAO56 Table 12 faba bean FRESH (not dry seed)
faba.duration_basis: FAO56 Table 11 broad bean 100-day Mediterranean example (Mar/Apr); season timing must be locally confirmed
faba.note: Fresh broad beans, not seed/dry faba. Duration and planting month are illustrative for Nile Delta. Sowing day remains original pilot convention, NOT an extension-service calendar.
faba.model_scope: Original FAO-56 representative example; not Egypt-calibrated

maize.name: Field maize (grain)
maize.kc_basis: FAO56 Table 12 field maize Kc initial=0.3 (cereal baseline), mid=1.2, end=0.35 in 0.35–0.6 range
maize.duration_basis: FAO56 Table 11 grain maize 125-day example (Nigeria/India), not Egypt-specific
maize.note: Representative grain maize; verify Kc and duration for local cultivar and management. Sowing day remains original pilot convention, NOT an extension-service calendar.
maize.model_scope: Original FAO-56 representative example; not Egypt-calibrated

sunflower.name: Sunflower (oilseed)
sunflower.kc_basis: FAO56 Table 12 oil crops Kc ini=0.35, sunflower mid 1.0–1.15 (choose illustrative 1.10), end=0.35
sunflower.duration_basis: FAO56 Table 11 sunflower 130-day Mediterranean example, April/May
sunflower.note: Representative sunflower crop coefficients, not local recommendations. Sowing day remains original pilot convention, NOT an extension-service calendar.
sunflower.model_scope: Original FAO-56 representative example; not Egypt-calibrated

rice.name: Paddy rice (flooded)
rice.kc_basis: FAO-56 Table 12; Kc end 0.90 is upper end of published 0.60-0.90
rice.duration_basis: FAO-56 Table 11; Rice May; Mediterranean 150 days; planting day 15 selected for ILLUSTRATION, NOT from FAO
rice.model_scope: atmospheric crop ET only; additional paddy water components NOT quantified
rice.note: The planting day is an explicit planning convention, not a validated local crop calendar. Site suitability cannot be concluded from Kc.

cotton.name: Cotton (fibre)
cotton.kc_basis: FAO-56 Table 12; Kc mid 1.15 and end 0.50 are published range endpoints
cotton.duration_basis: FAO-56 Table 11; Cotton 195 days; Egypt/Pakistan/California March-May; planting day 15 selected for ILLUSTRATION, NOT from FAO
cotton.note: The planting day is an explicit planning convention, not a validated local crop calendar. Site suitability cannot be concluded from Kc.

potato.name: Potato (tuber)
potato.kc_basis: FAO-56 Table 12; Kc initial 0.50 is FAO root/tuber group default
potato.duration_basis: FAO-56 Table 11; Potato 130 days; Jan/Nov semi-arid region; 45-day mid stage; planting day 15 selected for ILLUSTRATION, NOT from FAO
potato.note: The planting day is an explicit planning convention, not a validated local crop calendar. Site suitability cannot be concluded from Kc.

tomato.name: Tomato (fresh field)
tomato.kc_basis: FAO-56 Table 12; Kc end 0.70 is published 0.70-0.90 lower endpoint
tomato.duration_basis: FAO-56 Table 11; Tomato 145 days; April/May Mediterranean example; planting day 15 selected for ILLUSTRATION, NOT from FAO
tomato.note: The planting day is an explicit planning convention, not a validated local crop calendar. Site suitability cannot be concluded from Kc.

onion.name: Onion (dry bulb)
onion.kc_basis: FAO-56 Table 12; Kc initial 0.70 from small-vegetable group default
onion.duration_basis: FAO-56 Table 11; Dry onion 210 days; October/January arid region example; planting day 15 selected for ILLUSTRATION, NOT from FAO
onion.note: The planting day is an explicit planning convention, not a validated local crop calendar. Site suitability cannot be concluded from Kc.

sugarbeet.name: Sugar beet (root)
sugarbeet.kc_basis: FAO-56 Table 12; FAO Table 12 Sugar Beet direct row
sugarbeet.duration_basis: FAO-56 Table 11; Sugar beet 205 days; November arid region example; planting day 10 selected for ILLUSTRATION, NOT from FAO
sugarbeet.note: The planting day is an explicit planning convention, not a validated local crop calendar. Site suitability cannot be concluded from Kc.

alfalfa.name: Alfalfa hay (first cutting only)
alfalfa.kc_basis: FAO-56 Table 12; Individual cutting Kc Table 12; NOT a full multi-cut hay season
alfalfa.duration_basis: FAO-56 Table 11; Alfalfa first cutting 60 days; FAO-56 Table 11 California example; planting day 15 selected for ILLUSTRATION, NOT from FAO
alfalfa.model_scope: single first cutting only; NOT full season or rotation-ready
alfalfa.note: The planting day is an explicit planning convention, not a validated local crop calendar. Site suitability cannot be concluded from Kc.

sorghum.name: Grain sorghum
sorghum.kc_basis: FAO-56 Table 12; Kc mid 1.00 at lower end of published grain sorghum range 1.00–1.10
sorghum.duration_basis: FAO-56 Table 11; FAO-56 Table 11 sorghum May/June example: stage lengths sum to 125 although listed total is 130; the four published stage values are used; planting day 15 selected for ILLUSTRATION, NOT from FAO
sorghum.note: The planting day is an explicit planning convention, not a validated local crop calendar. Site suitability cannot be concluded from Kc.
